annotations.title: Add pictures to a brand kit

description: Adds pictures to a brand kit section — logo versions, product marks, example screenshots, imagery. Each file comes from a public https `url` (fetched by the server) or, for a small file that isn't online, base64 `data` with a `filename`. PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF and SVG, up to 20 MB each. Every file becomes a workspace file and an asset on the section, appended after the ones already there. Give each a `name` and a `note` saying what it's for; on logo sections set `backdrop` to the hex of the ground it's made for (#ffffff for a dark logo, #000000 for a reversed one), which is how pages pick the right version. Same rule as napkin_brand_draft: you can change any kit except the workspace's brand. Files that fail are reported and the rest still land.

backdrop.description: Hex of the ground it's made for (logos).

data.description: The file as base64, for small files.

filename.description: File name with extension. Required with `data`.

name.description: What to call it in the kit.

url.description: A public https address of the file.

kind.description: Only when no section has that title yet: the kind of section to make.

section.description: Title of the section to add them to, like Logo, Imagery or Examples.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.

name: napkin_brand_add_files
